card.name: Interplay and interface words
card.fires_on: The word play after "inter" in "interplay", and related words like "interface", "interfaces", "interphase" and "interfaced". It appears mostly in science and academic prose about interactions between factors.

modes.label: interplay
modes.description: The word "play" completing "interplay" before "of" or "between" a set of factors.

modes.label: interface words
modes.description: "interface", "interfaces" or "interfaced" as a boundary or connection.
